'''Pumpkin jam''' is the preservation of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pumpkin_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pumpkin jam takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Resistance I for 3:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
